summary: Anthropic re-accelerated in October 2026 after losing market share in summer 2026
summary_extended: Baker argues that Anthropic, after losing AI market share in summer 2026 (a call he claims to have made correctly), is now re-accelerating and gaining share as of October 2026. He bases this view on his read of Anthropic's S-1 filing, specifically inferring that the blank October ARR field was intentionally left empty to be filled with a strong, momentum-confirming number at the time of the IPO or filing completion. The investment implication is that Anthropic is regaining competitive positioning against rivals like OpenAI in the AI lab landscape, suggesting its valuation trajectory is positive. However, since both Anthropic and OpenAI remain private companies, there are no directly actionable US-listed equity plays implied by this specific thesis.
